text:
deploy-bot: post-deploy smoke summary for release r2026-03-21 at 18:00 UTC. eu-west-1 synth probes: embed p95 = 620ms (baseline 290ms) ; kv-prefill misses increased ~18% ; 502s 0.18% :warning:

maya: seeing that p95 bump too. is this across all synth buckets or just high-concurrency ones?

deploy-bot: synth breakdown attached (sampled):
```
sample_bucket: low-concurrency (1-2 req/s) -> p95 310ms
sample_bucket: medium (10-50 req/s) -> p95 420ms
sample_bucket: high (200-500 req/s) -> p95 610ms
concurrency_ramp: 40s -> 400s
```
kv-prefill: miss-rate spike at tail of ramp.

jon: thanks. sounds like sample density at high concurrency is pulling p95. i'm worried about request queues/backpressure on the embed pool. any correlating host GC or OOM?

deploy-bot: no host OOMs. GC pauses modest. queue_depth metric for embed-pool-eu peaked at 58 (norm <16).

tai: could be synth-sampler skew. recent deploy increased sample rate for embeds from 1:200 -> 1:100 in eu for better coverage. that doubles probe weight on heavy paths. recommend reverting sampler to 1:200 and re-run smoke quickly.

ops-liz: temporary mitigation: can we route non-critical embed traffic to us-west for 10m while we triage? fallback routing exists per rollout policy.

sam: +1 to reroute non-critical. i'd rather not roll back full release yet if it's localized.

noah: also suggest prefill warmup for embed-shards (command below) before changing sampler to limit cold miss tail:
```
# prefill top 20 shards for eu
infractl prefill --region eu-west-1 --model embed-large --shards 0..19 --concurrency 8
```

maya: agree. plan proposal: 1) revert synth-sampler to 1:200 for eu (quick config flip) 2) prefill top 20 shards 3) enable fallback routing for non-critical embed endpoints to us-west for 15m 4) monitor p95 and queue_depth for 10m before doing any pin/rollback.

jon: if after 10m p95 still >2x baseline or 502s >0.5% -> escalate to hold and pin to previous variant `embed-v3.2.0` for eu region. otherwise lift mitigations.

ops-liz: I'll open a short-lived routing override and tag it `temp-route-eu->usw-2026-03-21`. Applying now.

deploy-bot: synth-sampler revert applied: `synth-config/eu/sampling=1:200` at 18:02 UTC. prefill job queued (job id 9a7f). fallback route enabled for endpoints: `embed.search` and `embed.batch` (non-critical).

sam: running quick smoke now. will post results in ~3m.

deploy-bot: quick-smoke (3m window) results:
```
eu embed p95 (post-mitigations) = 340ms
kv-prefill misses down to +6% over baseline
502s = 0.06%
queue_depth peak = 20
```

maya: looking much better. thanks team.

jon: good. keep mitigations for 10m then remove fallback route and let prefill finish. if metrics stable, no pin.

noah: I'll keep an eye on cost delta for routing; fallback adds cross-region egress but it's short.

ops-liz: route removal scheduled at 18:17 UTC unless someone objects.

sam: lg. I'll post a short note to release notes: "post-deploy synth spike mitigated via sampler revert and shard prefill; no rollback required."

maya: assign follow-up action: infra to add a canary check that measures sample-density sensitivity and alerts when high-concurrency buckets move >1.5x baseline p95. created ticket INFRA-1428.

jon: thanks—closing thread unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
